idx_outbox_pending.name: idx_outbox_pending
idx_outbox_pending.where: processed_at IS NULL AND failed_at IS NULL

export_operation_file.name: export_operation_file
export_operation_file.value: ("export_operations"."state"='preparing' and "export_operations"."file" is null) or ("export_operations"."state" in('ready','sending') and "export_operations"."file" is not null) or "export_operations"."state"='cleanup'

conversion_job_state_fields.name: conversion_job_state_fields
conversion_job_state_fields.value: ("conversion_jobs"."state" = 'running' AND "conversion_jobs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "conversion_jobs"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL AND "conversion_jobs"."failure" IS NULL) OR ("conversion_jobs"."state" = 'failed' AND "conversion_jobs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "conversion_jobs"."lease_until" IS NULL AND "conversion_jobs"."failure" IS NOT NULL) OR ("conversion_jobs"."state" IN ('queued','succeeded','cancelled') AND "conversion_jobs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "conversion_jobs"."lease_until" IS NULL AND "conversion_jobs"."failure" IS NULL)

notes_one_owner.name: notes_one_owner
notes_one_owner.value: ("notes"."owner_account_id" IS NOT NULL) != ("notes"."owner_workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)

notes_lifecycle_valid.name: notes_lifecycle_valid
notes_lifecycle_valid.value: ("notes"."lifecycle" = 'active' AND "notes"."trashed_at" IS NULL AND "notes"."purge_after" IS NULL AND "notes"."trash_operation_id" IS NULL) OR ("notes"."lifecycle" = 'trashed' AND "notes"."trashed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "notes"."purge_after" IS NOT NULL AND "notes"."purge_after" > "notes"."trashed_at" AND "notes"."trash_operation_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("notes"."lifecycle" = 'purging' AND "notes"."trashed_at" IS NULL AND "notes"."purge_after" IS NULL AND "notes"."trash_operation_id" IS NOT NULL)

note_sharing_token_fields.name: note_sharing_token_fields
note_sharing_token_fields.value: ("note_sharing"."link_generation"=0 and "note_sharing"."token_hash" is null and "note_sharing"."token_envelope" is null and "note_sharing"."password_hash" is null and "note_sharing"."visibility"='private') or ("note_sharing"."link_generation">0 and "note_sharing"."token_hash" is not null and "note_sharing"."token_envelope" is not null)

purge_manual_actor.name: purge_manual_actor
purge_manual_actor.value: ("note_purges"."cause"='manual' AND "note_purges"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "note_purges"."workspace_deletion_id" IS NULL) OR ("note_purges"."cause"='expired' AND "note_purges"."workspace_deletion_id" IS NULL) OR ("note_purges"."cause"='workspace-deletion' AND "note_purges"."account_id" IS NULL AND "note_purges"."workspace_deletion_id" IS NOT NULL AND "note_purges"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)

profile_icon_output.name: profile_icon_output
profile_icon_output.value: "account_profile_icons"."state" not in ('writing','ready') or ("account_profile_icons"."sha256" is not null and "account_profile_icons"."width" is not null and "account_profile_icons"."height" is not null and "account_profile_icons"."width">0 and "account_profile_icons"."height">0)

reference_job_fields.name: reference_job_fields
reference_job_fields.value: ("reference_jobs"."state"='running' AND "reference_jobs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "reference_jobs"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL AND "reference_jobs"."failure" IS NULL) OR ("reference_jobs"."state"='failed' AND "reference_jobs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "reference_jobs"."lease_until" IS NULL AND "reference_jobs"."failure" IS NOT NULL) OR ("reference_jobs"."state" IN ('queued','succeeded','cancelled') AND "reference_jobs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "reference_jobs"."lease_until" IS NULL AND "reference_jobs"."failure" IS NULL)

workspace_deletion_state_fields.name: workspace_deletion_state_fields
workspace_deletion_state_fields.value: ("workspace_deletions"."state"='queued' AND "workspace_deletions"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "workspace_deletions"."lease_until" IS NULL AND "workspace_deletions"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_deletions"."state"='running' AND "workspace_deletions"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_deletions"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_deletions"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_deletions"."state"='succeeded' AND "workspace_deletions"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "workspace_deletions"."lease_until" IS NULL AND "workspace_deletions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

workspace_profile_state.name: workspace_profile_state
workspace_profile_state.value: ("workspaces"."state"='active' AND "workspaces"."creator_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspaces"."name" IS NOT NULL AND "workspaces"."description" IS NOT NULL AND "workspaces"."created_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("workspaces"."state"='deleted' AND "workspaces"."creator_id" IS NULL AND "workspaces"."name" IS NULL AND "workspaces"."description" IS NULL AND "workspaces"."created_at" IS NULL AND "workspaces"."icon_id" IS NULL)
